description: Call conversions posted to the Google Ads API UploadCallConversions method. UploadClickConversions stays vendor/google-ads-click-conversions. Conversion adjustments are vendor/google-ads-conversion-adjustments. The image pixel is a different pack.

params.name: conversions
params.fix_hint: Send at least one CallConversion in `conversions`.

params.name: partialFailure
params.description: Google documents `partial_failure` as required, and the upload guides say to always send true.

params.name: conversionAction
params.description: It is the conversion action resource name, and every uploaded call conversion requires it.

params.name: callerId
params.description: It is the caller phone number. Google documents E.164 with a leading `+`.

params.name: callStartDateTime
params.description: Google documents the call start time as `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss+|-hh:mm`.

params.name: conversionDateTime
params.description: Google documents the conversion time with a timezone offset as `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss+|-hh:mm`. It must be after the call start.

params.name: conversionValue
params.description: It is the conversion value for the advertiser. Google documents a non-negative number together with `currencyCode`.
params.fix_hint: Send a number such as `1.0`, with no currency symbol, together with `currencyCode`.

params.name: currencyCode
params.description: It is an ISO 4217 currency code for `conversionValue`.
params.fix_hint: Use the three-letter code, such as `USD`.

params.name: consent.adUserData
params.description: Google documents `consent.ad_user_data` on the CallConversion object.

rules.message: The conversion sends `conversionValue` without `currencyCode`. Google documents the ISO 4217 code together with the value.
The conversion sends `currencyCode` without `conversionValue`. Google documents both together.
